units.source_text: 宽广的门底下，除了这男子以外，再没有别的谁。

en.t: Under the broad gate, there was no one at all except this man.

units.source_text: 只在朱漆剥落的大的圆柱上，停着一匹的蟋蟀。

en.t: Only on a large round pillar where the vermilion lacquer had peeled away, a single cricket was perched.

units.source_text: 这罗生门，既然在朱雀大路上，则这男子之外，总还该有两三个避雨的市女笠和揉乌帽子的。

en.t: Since this Rashomon stood on Suzaku Avenue, there ought to have been two or three others besides this man, people in ichimegasa hats or soft eboshi caps sheltering from the rain.

units.source_text: 然而除了这男子，却再没有别的谁。

en.t: Yet apart from this man, there was no one else at all.
